name: SAMPLE machine: sampler for samples on the +Drive, one shot or loop, forward or reverse (Cycles One-Shot 0.17)
description: Plays a sample from the +Drive once per trig, or in a loop (MACHINES + PUNCH), forward or reverse (MACHINES + GATE): 6-tap polyphase at 96 kHz, the stock decimator, the amp chain set up like TONE, then the Model:Samples' filter. A loop goes round what Start and Length select with a hard seam, as on the Model:Samples, so a single cycle loops without a step; a trig that cuts a sounding note brings the new one in over 0.67 ms. The sample is chosen in the PRESET browser and saved with the sound, the switches too; while the browser's cursor rests on a sample file, the pad and the TRIG keys play that sample with the track's settings, as the Model:Samples does, silent until it has loaded in the background; while the track's pad is held, its trigs play it too (those with a sample lock their own), and let go, the note goes on in the track's sample at the same place; with trigs held, MACHINES + PUNCH or GATE locks Loop or Reverse on those steps instead (a p-lock of k 32 the voice reads at the trig), and while a trig is held the right half of the screen shows whether that step plays them. The main screen shows the pattern's number, the track's number, pan and level, the sample's name with L and R while the switches are on, and its waveform; FUNC + LEVEL/DATA's pan lands on even values on its tracks, so 0 is always reached; with a trig held, turning Start or Length shows the whole view for that trig, its sample (a sample lock's own) and its locks on the waveform. Start and Length act on the note that plays: once, Length moves its end (its fade-out stays whole) and Start waits for the next trig; a loop takes its end at once and its start from the next seam, as the Model:Samples does. Cutoff and Reso show the Model:Samples' own pictures in the knob view, the frames the Cycles OS builds at boot.

uses.why: Loop, a switch: bit 8 of k 32, which the voice reads in the note's sound every block; the shortcut layer flips and saves it
Reverse, a switch: bit 9 of k 32, which the voice reads in the note's sound at the trig; the shortcut layer flips and saves it
the browser reads the opened file: a sample file on a SAMPLE track names the sample instead

a pad plays its note (0x4001d05e, called only by the pads' handler): SAMPLE notes the track's pad as held, for the browser's preview, and while the browser marks a sample for the active track sends the note's note-off at once (0x4008145e, as the Model:Samples' browser does), so the held pad's track takes its trigs
a pad ends its note (0x4001d0fc): the track's pad let go

a TRIG key plays its note in CHROMATIC mode (0x40019e7a, called only by the keyboard's handler): while the browser marks a sample for the active track SAMPLE sends the note's note-off at once (0x4008145e), so the track's trigs play on in the track's own sample and cut the key's note; the key is not a held pad

the browser's cursor rests on a file (0x400a63ac reads it as a preset): a sample file on a SAMPLE track gives the track's sound naming it, which the OS marks for the pad and the TRIG keys as it marks a preset; the tick then loads the marked sample
sound to record, version 2: the sample's key into record slots 24..27
record to sound: the key back
the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz: SAMPLE's card once (sample_card.c), then One-Shot's tick (smp_hook_tick), which loads and frees samples

FUNC + LEVEL/DATA on the main screen, one track: the pan + step the OS sets comes from smp_pan_step; on a SAMPLE track a pan on an odd value lands on the even value next to it (the OS steps by 2 and clamps at 63)
the same with TRACK held, for each track
MainScreenView's draw method: the waveform on a SAMPLE track
the knob view's draw method: SAMPLE's view while Start or Length turns, with a trig held for that trig and its locks
NoteVelocityView's draw method: it leaves the left half to SAMPLE's view while a held trig's Start or Length is shown, so the waveform keeps its 105 columns

formatters.why: an interface object has one formatter, and object 53 is also SNARE's SWEEP: smp_fmt_cutoff falls back to the stock one off SAMPLE's tracks and is put in only while the stock one is there (machine/view.c)

pictures.why: an interface object has one picture, and object 53 is also SNARE's SWEEP: smp_pic_cutoff falls back to SNARE's off SAMPLE's tracks and is put in only while SNARE's is there (machine/view.c)
the same for object 54, SNARE's CONTOUR: smp_pic_reso

emulation.preview: One-Shot 0.16, tools/emu/test_sampler_preview.py (Unicorn, 2026-11-12), the payload of SAMPLE playing a note, instructions per block: 3034 on 0.15, 3042 on 0.16, 3063 with the pad held, 3625 in the one block it is let go, with the pad's and the TRIG keys' note-off at once (notes/60 §24)

device.status: the CPU page on a Model:Cycles (the maintainer, 2026-11-12): CPU and PEAK as with release 0.60 while a SAMPLE track plays; the held pad is not measurable there (the browser and the page are never open together)

changes: the filter runs inside the machine, before Volume + Dist; the Model:Samples has it after
on its tracks, MACHINES held + PUNCH or GATE flips Loop or Reverse instead of PUNCH or GATE, and their LEDs show those switches while MACHINES is held

on its tracks, while the PRESET browser marks a sample, the pad's note gets its note-off at once, so the track's trigs keep playing while the pad is held (the stock OS mutes a track while its pad is held); with GATE on that note no longer holds
on its tracks, FUNC + LEVEL/DATA's pan on an odd value (63 at the right end) moves one less, onto the even value next to it, so the column's number reaches 0 again; 2 a step as before
unchanged: at Cutoff 0 the track is untouched bit for bit
presets on other machines load as before
TRACK + PUNCH or GATE (Control All), with or without MACHINES
FUNC + LEVEL/DATA's pan on other machines' tracks, and the volume

conflicts_declared.why: plays sample files from the same browser and needs Model-TG
